features.title: Topic to video
features.what: The topic becomes a video draft.
features.evidence_quote: 从主题自动完成脚本、配音、素材、字幕、配乐和剪辑

features.title: Media options
features.what: Use local images and video or stock footage.
features.evidence_quote: 支持上传自己的 **本地图片和视频**

features.title: Flexible editing
features.what: Customize content throughout the video workflow.
features.evidence_quote: 也支持在每个环节使用自定义内容

features.title: Service credentials
features.what: External providers may need API credentials.
features.evidence_quote: 首次启动时，项目会根据 `config.example.toml` 自动创建 `config.toml`

risks.text: Provider costs and media rights vary; review output.
